abilities.name: Spec Ops Armour
abilities.text: This Unit gains the HIDDEN Status until it performs another action.

abilities.name: Commando Stimpack
abilities.text: This Unit gains BUFF Speed (3). Additionally, its Quad K12 and all Close Combat Weapons gain PRECISION (2).

abilities.name: Magrail Munitions
abilities.text: This Unit's first Attack in the game with its Quad K12 gains PIERCE Armoured (3).

abilities.name: Suppression Shells
abilities.text: When an Enemy declares a Charge against a Friendly Unit Within 8″, that Enemy gains DEBUFF Speed (3).
